reuse.why: Builds on the existing withBankAccountLinkCheck wrapper and linkBankSyncAccount, extracts the holder query from assertBankAccountNotLinked and the unlink field reset from unlinkAccount so both old and new paths share them.

duplication.why: No logic is copied: findBankAccountHolder and clearAccountBankLink are extracted and reused by the existing assertion and unlinkAccount.

placement.why: Everything stays in accounts/app.ts next to the link checks, though the flag is handled in two layers (the wrapper skips the assertion while linkBankSyncAccount does the takeover), splitting one decision across them.

scope.why: Focused on the takeover flag, but it also drops an await from an unrelated existing test line (db.runQuery in the reopened-account test).

maintainability.why: Small, readable extractions a maintainer can own; the split of the replace decision between wrapper and link function is the only wrinkle.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through withBankAccountLinkCheck and linkBankSyncAccount; unlinkAccount's reset is shared rather than bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: Shared logic was extracted (findBankAccountHolder, clearAccountBankLink), not reshaped copies.
